title: program/evidence/<ID>/results/<utc>-<sha256[:12]>.json
description: Appended by pk's evidence kit (Evidence.write), never modified, named by the sha256 of its bytes, named by program/evidence/<ID>/latest.json while it is the task's latest, and checked by `pk evidence validate`. Its inputs never name a derived output (`pk evidence lint`). Only a gate record carries children. The checker enforces the same shape in code; its list of required keys is read from this file. This is the record the hand-back gate, the binding check and `pk status set ... done` accept: they refuse a planted-bug row without path, find, replace, build_argv or test_argv, where `pk evidence validate` alone checks those five only when a row carries them.

head.description: the one commit the evidence binds to

main.description: SHA of the main branch when produced

inputs.description: root-relative path -> sha256 of the blob committed at head

argv.description: the literal command, never a shell string

as_expected.description: exit equals expected_exit and any parse succeeded

derived.description: fields parsed from the real output

output_sha256.description: over the full combined stdout and stderr

planted_bugs.description: one row per planted bug, then exactly one self-test row (id self-test-noncompiling, builds false, killed false)

killed.description: true only when the code built and the test failed

kill_reason.description: build failed iff builds is false; test failed iff killed; else not killed

path.description: the file the bug was planted in, relative to the root

find.description: the text that was replaced; empty in the self-test row, which appends

replace.description: what it was replaced with; in the self-test row, the appended line

build_argv.description: the build command run on the edited file; null when no build step was given

test_argv.description: the test command whose exit decided killed

planted_bugs_all_killed.description: over the rows except the self-test row

tree_unchanged_by_run.description: clean at the start, clean at the end, same HEAD

supersedes.description: digest of the task's previous latest results record, or null for its first

children.description: a gate record only: the child records it binds by digest, with each child's drift at the gate's head
